items: correctness-1: One presentation profile per install (language, register, audience) is per-install state, never repo content, written by install/sync, and is the single source every presentation surface derives from.

correctness-2: The profile reaches every Claude session on the machine (interactive sessions and smine skill runs alike) through the global-context hook injection of context/global/presentation-profile.md.

correctness-3: The profile carries an explicit supersede clause over the global 'handoff/doc artifacts: always English' rule, scoped to end-user-visible text only; the claude-configs repo content, logs, results.jsonl and other operator artifacts stay English.

correctness-4: The profile doc carries the German semi-casual/semi-professional register directive plus a jargon glossary mapping banned engine/developer terms (worktree, ACDSL gate, transcript mining, consolidate) to plain-German replacements.

correctness-5: The nightly consolidate stage threads the profile language (`language de`) into `/smine-consolidate proposals`, making consolidate the style-correction gate that rewrites drifted English/jargon prose in the proposal store.
correctness-6: snippets[].code, ids, dates, tags and gate fields are never translated or reworded by any language pass.

correctness-7: The config server UI gets a German overlay (message catalog over the pages the non-developer sees, template strings plus Go-originated labels) with English as default and fallback, and the html `lang` attribute is driven by the profile instead of hardcoded `en`.
correctness-8: For the non-developer audience the navigation hides the engine-internal tabs (Skills, Context, Repos, Tools) and keeps Overview, Proposals and Sessions.
correctness-9: For the non-developer audience proposal cards hide gate band, tags and target internals; code snippets render collapsed, clearly marked as technical detail, and untranslated.
correctness-10: Audience gating is a render-time filter over the same data (no forked handlers); switching the profile back to developer/English restores the full UI surface and register.
correctness-11: For the German non-developer user, proposal titles, change lines and detail fields read in plain German without developer terms.
correctness-12: Evidence notes are phrased as everyday explanations of what happened in the user's sessions, judgeable without knowing how the mining engine works.
correctness-13: Engine terms (worktree, gate, transcript mining, consolidation) never appear in text the non-developer user reads.
correctness-14: Navigation and page headings render in German for the German non-developer user.
correctness-15: The non-developer user sees only the pages relevant to them (overview, proposals, sessions) and is not shown internals such as skills, context packs or repo-management internals.
correctness-16: Proposal cards for the non-developer user show no gate bands, tags or target paths — only what is suggested and why.
correctness-17: Nightly runs keep user-visible content German and jargon-free so English developer prose does not leak in over time.
correctness-18: Technical code blocks are visibly marked as technical detail and left untranslated.
correctness-19: The operator sets the presentation profile once at install and the machine is then fully configured for its user without ongoing manual styling.
correctness-20: The operator can switch a machine back to developer/English mode and get the full UI and register.
correctness-21: Repo content, logs and pipeline results stay English regardless of the profile.

correctness-22: The profile lives at `~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md` with a `---`-delimited front matter carrying `language:` and `audience:` and a directive body; the same file is parsed by Go (server) and by `sed` (run.sh), and its body is injected verbatim into sessions.

correctness-23: Missing, unreadable or malformed profile, missing front matter or missing keys fail open to defaults (language `en`, developer audience); unknown audience values count as developer; empty language defaults to `en`; with no profile file the UI, nav and nightly prompt are byte-identical to pre-change behavior.

correctness-24: `cmd/hooks/global-context.sh` scans `$HOME/.claude/context/global/*.md` before the repo-local `$DOCS_DIR/global/*.md`, under the existing `GLOBAL_CONTEXT_ENABLED` kill switch, with the GLOBAL CONTEXT header and per-file header format unchanged, bash-3.2 compatible and shellcheck-clean.

correctness-25: `loadPresentationProfile` (internal/server/presentation.go) reads only the first front-matter block; `DefaultPresentationPath()` is exported and backs a new configserver `-presentation` flag whose value lands in `Options.PresentationPath` (zero value = defaults).

correctness-26: The template FuncMap provides `t` (translate profile language over English source strings, identity when language is not `de` or the key is missing), `langAttr` (profile language) and `isDeveloperAudience`.

correctness-27: `internal/server/i18n.go` holds `germanCatalog` keyed by the English source string with identity fallback; the catalog covers every literal the non-developer sees in layout, overview, proposals, sessions_index, sessions_batch, _batch_list, _proposal_card and the sessionTiles/proposalsTile labels (Go fmt.Sprintf composites may stay English per S8).

correctness-28: layout.html renders `<html lang="{{langAttr}}">`, wraps Overview/Sessions/Proposals nav labels in `t`, and gates Config, Skills, Context, Repos, Routines, Tools, Checklist and Peek anchors on `isDeveloperAudience`; direct URLs to hidden pages stay reachable.

correctness-29: `handleOverview` for a non-developer audience appends only `sessionTiles` and `proposalsTile` and renders with a translated title; overview.html renders tile labels via `{{t .Label}}`.
correctness-30: For the non-developer audience `_proposal_card.html` hides the target badge, gate band badges, tag badges and the gate detail row; for developers the card is unchanged.

correctness-31: The card's comment placeholders (incl. the disabled-form one), postpone button and details/fields/evidence summary labels go through `t`; the snippet summary shows kind/lang/source for developers and `t "technical detail"` (Technisches Detail) otherwise; static texts in proposals.html, sessions_index.html, sessions_batch.html and _batch_list.html are wrapped in `t`.

correctness-32: routines/smine-nightly/run.sh parses `language:` from the profile with `sed`; when set and not `en` the consolidate prompt becomes `/smine-consolidate proposals language <lang>`, otherwise it stays `/smine-consolidate proposals`.

correctness-33: `settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md` ships in the repo with `language: de` and the directive body (German prose, semi-casual register, banned-term glossary, never translate code/ids/dates/tags/paths/snippets, collapse technical fragments as Technisches Detail).

correctness-34: install.sh copies `settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.${SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE}.md` to `~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md` (mkdir -p) only when `SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE` is set; a default install never plants a profile.

correctness-35: configserver gains a `-presentation-profile` flag passed into `runInstall` (Windows and non-Windows stub signatures identical); after `runSyncs` succeeds `installPresentationProfile` copies the repo template to `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\context\global\presentation-profile.md`, an empty id installs nothing, and errors follow the file's existing error package.

correctness-36: installer/windows/smine.iss adds a `TInputOptionWizardPage` after RepoPage with the developer/English default checked and a German option, a `ProfileArg` function appending ` -presentation-profile=de` only for the German choice, and the `[Run]` entry uses `-install{code:ProfileArg}`; install.ps1 gains a `-PresentationProfile` parameter forwarded as `-presentation-profile=`.

correctness-37: settings/claude_code/CLAUDE.md's artifact-language rule gains the supersede clause: an installed presentation profile overrides it for end-user-visible artifacts; code, logs, commits and repo docs stay English.
correctness-38: Every profile id the Windows wizard maps has a matching `settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.<id>.md` template file.

correctness-39: Canonical skills-group titles ('New skills', 'Edits to existing skills', 'Workflows (skill-bundled scripts)', 'Considered, not proposed') stay verbatim in proposal JSON (smine-apply routes on them) and are translated only at render time.

correctness-40: proposals.html renders the kind heading as `{{t .File.Kind}}`, the 'updated' meta, 'Everything applied, happy' and 'file(s) failed to load:' literals through `t`, and category/group/subgroup section titles as `{{t .Title}}` (identity fallback keeps free-form and path titles intact).

correctness-41: proposals.go vote tooltips are built from catalog format-string keys via the profile-language translate (`%d of %d accepted`, `%d rejected`, `%d postponed`); category names stay untouched Go keys and translate via the template section-title `t`.

correctness-42: Remaining Go-composed non-dev-visible overview strings (signalDetail fragments, the `%+d vs batch %d` delta) go through translate, and overview window filter labels render as `{{t .Label}}`.

correctness-43: germanCatalog gains the D7/P1 entries (New skills→Neue Funktionen, Edits to existing skills→Änderungen an bestehenden Funktionen, Workflows (skill-bundled scripts)→Abläufe (gebündelte Skripte), Considered, not proposed→Geprüft, nicht vorgeschlagen, context, routines, rules, actions, facts, acdsl, updated, empty-state, load-error and the tooltip/delta format strings) with keys byte-identical to the template/Go literals.

correctness-44: Developer machines (no profile) render every page byte-identically; the proposals/sessions schema, canonical group titles in data, ids, targets, paths, snippets, dates and status enums do not change.

correctness-45: smine-batch, smine-skills, smine-routines, smine-context and smine-memory SKILL.md each gain a Language contract: read the presentation profile; when `language:` is set and not `en`, author the user-visible prose fields in that language following the profile's register and glossary; never translate ids, targets, paths, code, dates, tags, schema keys, status values or the fixed group titles; absent profile = English; each skill's frontmatter version and changelog.json[0] bump together.

correctness-46: The user-visible prose field set is: proposals — title change-name part after `<target> — `, change, fields[].label/text, evidence[].title, sessions[].note, free-form group titles; batches — batch title, theme bullets, arc summaries, per-session summaries/notes, finding titles; batch .md reports, ledgers and run reports stay English.
correctness-47: smine-context and smine-memory group titles (target-surface paths) are excluded from translation; smine-skills keeps its mandated group titles explicitly flagged as verbatim keys.

correctness-48: smine-consolidate's `language <lang>` makes all user-visible prose of the mutable set end up in `<lang>` — untouched entries not in `<lang>` are translated in place, free-form group titles included — while fixed structural titles and technical identifiers stay verbatim, voted/non-proposed entries stay immutable, the grouping invariant and §4 Presentation are amended accordingly, and the skill version bumps.
correctness-49: The rollout note documents a one-time `/smine-consolidate proposals language de` run (or next nightly) to translate the already-seeded store; no migration code is added.
correctness-50: cmd/sync/sync_hooks.sh's prune prompt reads `read -r answer || answer=n`, so EOF/no stdin never aborts the install and never prunes without an explicit yes.

correctness-51: internal/shell gains `SyncTimeout = 10 * time.Minute` and `RunSync` mirroring RunDialog (platformArgv, HideWindow, WaitDelay, log line, wrapped error); all four sync-script call sites (install_windows.go x2, contextdocs/sync.go, skills/sync.go) use it, leaving no `shell.Run` on sync_*/ensure_git_repo.

correctness-52: sync_skills.sh, when the installed profile has the non-developer (casual) audience, jq-merges `skillOverrides: {<leaf>: "off"}` for every deployed leaf into `~/.claude/settings.json` preserving foreign keys and writes `~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json` with the same leaves `"on"`; on a developer profile it deletes the overlay and drops the leaf overrides via jq del (idempotent flip).

correctness-53: Pipeline runs re-enable hidden skills at project/local scope: sync_skills.sh merges the on-map into the repo's `.claude/settings.local.json`, run.sh copies the overlay into each routine worktree's `.claude/settings.local.json`, the file is gitignored so publish never commits it, and no `--settings` injection is used.

correctness-54: For the non-developer audience /repos renders as Projekte: `{{t "Projects"}}` heading, add/remove forms with t-localized labels and confirm text, the additional-dir checkbox only for developers, a table of unlinked project names/labels without Path/Context/ACDSL/Worktrees columns; the non-dev nav gains a Projekte link after Vorschläge; every route stays reachable on every install.
correctness-55: `handleReposAdd` applies the additionalDirectories grant when the checkbox is set OR the audience is non-developer; developer behavior without the checkbox is unchanged.
correctness-56: Adding a folder without `.git` (dir or file) runs `git init -b main` there via internal/shell before `registry.Add` (no remote ever configured); an init failure fails the add.

correctness-57: `repos.Repo` gains optional `Label` (`json:"label,omitempty"`, length-capped at 80, display-only, never the URL/dedup key); the add form gets a label input for both audiences; Projekte rows and the dev Name column show the label falling back to the name.
correctness-58: germanCatalog gains the Projects/Projekte, add/remove/Add/Remove, `label (optional)`, confirm and `No repos registered.` → `Noch keine Projekte.` entries.

correctness-59: A new `smine-orchestrate` skill (+ changelog.json) with `argument-hint: "<branch> | bootstrap"` and an allowed-tools manifest (Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git *), Bash(jq *), Bash(make audit *), Bash(go run ./cmd/acdsl *), Bash(bash cmd/sync/*), ToolSearch) covering every prescribed step.

correctness-60: orchestrate `<branch>` mode: judge main..<branch> (schema-valid sessions/proposals JSON, `make audit` green, prose vs the profile; auto-applied changes re-judged, a bad one reverted with its proposal set rejected and reasoned; small defects fixed on the branch; hopeless → reject, reason to `.orchestrate-report`, no merge); merge into main after verifying the checkout, `make audit` on main with a red result reverting the merge; then sync settings/hooks/skills, re-run sync_context.sh per repos.json target with its recorded options (per-repo failures non-fatal), append-only additionalDirectories reconciliation, push only when a remote exists, one report line per duty.

correctness-61: orchestrate `bootstrap` mode judges the working tree with initial-setup framing (lenient on seeding volume, strict on schema/audit/style), commits directly with no branch or merge, and runs the same sync/reconcile/push/report duties.

correctness-62: run.sh parses `audience:` above stage 1; `ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE` defaults on and `SMINE_AUTO_APPLY` defaults to `decide` for the non-developer audience (env overrides win); stage 3 runs only when exit and publish status are 0, from repo_root with the captured run branch, via `routine_run_claude 3600` with the `routine_allowed_tools smine-orchestrate` manifest and `--effort medium`; `ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE=0` skips it.

correctness-63: Stage-3 wrapper postconditions: a dirty repo_root tree marks the stage failed (70); a run branch that is an ancestor of main is pruned via `routine_prune_merged`, otherwise it is kept and the reason plus `.orchestrate-report` tail are logged; `.orchestrate-report` is always removed; the stage status propagates into the run exit status.

correctness-64: The Welcome page gets a Bootstrap card mirroring the verify-token control (hx-post `/welcome/bootstrap`, hx-confirm, indicator); the handler refuses a second concurrent run with a conflict, starts the child detached with output to a log under the routine logs dir and a logged pid, and responds started; `GET /welcome/bootstrap/status` resolves the newest running session via the peek client and renders the session id + peek link, else starting.
correctness-65: The Welcome nav anchor gating reverts to plain `{{if initWelcome}}` (no audience condition).

correctness-66: Developer machines are unchanged: no skillOverrides written, no stage 3, apply default `never`, full UI; the Windows folder picker change is evidence-first (owner form shown and activated so the dialog opens in front) with no speculative rewrite.

correctness-67: `acdsl/policy.json` ships with `mode: free`, `dist_mode: gated`, `base_ref: ""`, `editable_scopes: [GOLANG, PYTHON, SHELL, SQL, JSON]`, empty `verifier_allowlist` and `local_overrides`, `allow_task_contracts: true`; `acdsl/policy.schema.json` (draft-07, additionalProperties false, required mode, mode/dist_mode enums free|gated|strict, scope items `^[A-Z]{2,12}$`) validates it.
correctness-68: New rule `ACDSL-JSON-003` (jsonschema verifier, reach global, anchor `^acdsl/policy\.json$`, schema acdsl/policy.schema.json, empty ok, needs the schema) gates the policy file.

correctness-69: `LoadPolicy` returns free mode with AllowTaskContracts true for an absent file, preserves `allow_task_contracts: true` when the key is absent, errors on malformed JSON and on an unknown mode (never a silent free).

correctness-70: `CheckPolicy` is compiled into `acdsl check` (not a registry verifier): wired in runCheck after LoadRegistry, LoadPolicy/CheckPolicy errors exit 2, policy diagnostics are prepended to Check's and logged through logVerdicts; free mode never diffs; when HEAD is the base tip the check is vacuous.

correctness-71: policyBase resolves merge-base(HEAD, ref) over candidates `base_ref`, `origin/HEAD`, `origin/main`, `main`, `master`; no resolvable candidate in strict/gated is a hard error (exit 2) naming the remediation, never a pass.

correctness-72: surfaceDelta flags each of acdsl/policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, evalgen.json whose working content differs from `git show <base>:<path>` (absent on one side is a difference, absent on both is clean).
correctness-73: overlayViolations reads acdsl/registry.local.json directly (tracked or untracked) and flags every entry name missing from `local_overrides`.

correctness-74: ruleDelta parses declaration files changed vs base (diff --name-only plus untracked) on both sides and classifies added/removed/changed by trimmed marker-line byte equality; ruleViolations flags every entry in strict, and in gated flags entries whose SCOPE segment (non-matching ids protected) is outside editable_scopes plus added/changed entries binding a verifier outside the allowlist (empty = base-ref registry names); task-lifetime entries are dropped first when allow_task_contracts.

correctness-75: Policy diagnostics carry Message `<file>:<line>: policy(<mode>): rule <id> added|modified|removed outside <detail>`, RuleId `ACDSL-POLICY`, Verifier `policy`, and a Why naming the fix (sanction on the base ref, or revert).

correctness-76: internal/acdsl/git.go gains GitMergeBase, GitRevParse, GitChangedFiles (diff --name-only merged with untracked non-ignored) and GitShowFile (absent path → ok=false, never an error), all via internal/shell.Run.

correctness-77: `Dist` writes the policy into the target with `mode` rewritten from `dist_mode` (falling back to the source mode) and `dist_mode` stripped, ships the schema verbatim, ships nothing when no source policy exists, and prints `acdsl/policy.json -> mode: <mode>`.

correctness-78: `cmd/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh` fails open (no jq → allow), locates the nearest acdsl/policy.json walking up from cwd, in gated/strict denies writes to policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, registry.local.json and evalgen.json, in strict also denies `*.acdsl` and `acdsl/*`, allows paths outside the policy repo, emits the worktree-write-guard deny JSON shape, and is bash-3.2 and shellcheck clean.

correctness-79: settings/claude_code/settings.json appends the guard to the PreToolUse `Write|Edit|NotebookEdit` hooks array after worktree-write-guard (`bash ~/.claude/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh`, timeout 10), deployed by sync_hooks.sh unchanged.

correctness-80: acdsl/README.md gains a Modes section (three modes, base-branch privilege boundary, dist_mode, local_overrides, task-contract exemption, copy-paste permissions.deny snippet) and an amended registry.local.json paragraph; docs/acdsl-spec.md gains a self-management modes paragraph; cmd/acdsl/main.go's doc comment mentions the policy gate.
correctness-81: smine itself stays in `free` mode so `make audit` and the smine-apply verifier-generation flow keep working; reach/projected semantics and existing verifiers are unchanged.

correctness-82: The railroad-review lane prompt invokes the Skill tool with `skill="railroad-review"` and `args="--no-context"`, so lanes receive no doctrine injection; `no-context` appears in railroad-review.js only at that site.

correctness-83: SKILL.md's CTX-002 parenthetical is corrected from '(they never invoke a skill)' to the real mechanism (lanes invoke the skill with --no-context; the direction's named entries remain the lane's only context).
correctness-84: railroad-review frontmatter version and changelog.json[0] bump together 8.2 → 8.3 with an entry naming the context fix and the branch rename.

correctness-85: Branch builders produce `claude-review/{direction}[-{chunkSlug}]-l{i}-r{r}-{hash6}` (lanes), `claude-review/refute-{slug}-r{r}-{hash6}` (refuters) and `claude-review/station-r{r}-{hash6}` (station); the cleanup enumeration derives from the same builders; no `claude/railroad` string remains under skills/quality/railroad-review/ and every 'claude/* namespace' prose mention becomes 'claude-review/*'.
correctness-86: After a round, cleanup leaves no `claude-review/*` branches behind.

correctness-87: `plans/railroad-review-observability/runbooks/trace.md` holds disk-only jq recipes (lane roster, per-lane context reads vs direction requirements, injection check, per-agent cost/time rollup, step adherence) plus the before/after v8.2/v8.3 procedure, with no peek-mcp dependency.

correctness-88: `plans/railroad-review-observability/runbooks/eviction-screen.md` defines candidates as entries never read by a lane whose direction requires them AND never cited AND enforcement not gate/lint across ≥3 traced runs, writing `evals/railroad-review-<date>/eviction-candidates.md` as input to a manual tombstone decision; no confidence/labels/usage counters are added to context entries.

correctness-89: The peek verbose mode is recorded as a contract only (session_agents, session_agent_events with events_only, session_full include_thinking for main-agent thinking only); peek-mcp stays at v1.2.1 and skill-context.sh/read-gate.sh are unchanged.

correctness-90: The Welcome Bootstrap card becomes a form (hx-post `/welcome/bootstrap`, hx-confirm kept) with a native `<input type="date" name="since">` prefilled with today−30d and max today, an `extra-prompt` text input (maxlength 500) and a submit button; `BootstrapSinceDefault`/`BootstrapToday` (2006-01-02) are computed in the welcome page handler.
correctness-91: smine gains `--since <YYYY-MM-DD>` (argument-hint, Args, §1 Resolve, §2 Run) passed verbatim to smine-batch, and session-mine.js forwards `args.since` like `agents`.
correctness-92: smine-batch `--since` drops sessions whose `last_active` is before the date (inclusive floor) before batching, never listing them as skipped, then orders newest → oldest.
correctness-93: The audience constant becomes `audienceCasual = "casual"` and `isDeveloperAudience()` compares against it (predicate name and template polarity unchanged).

correctness-94: sync_skills.sh migrates an existing profile in place (`audience: non-developer` → `audience: casual`, tmp + mv) before reading, compares against `casual`, and leaves a file whose audience is neither value untouched; run.sh's orchestrate and auto-apply comparisons use `casual`.
correctness-95: The German template writes `audience: casual` and 'casual user' prose, and the Windows installer option label reads '(German, casual)'.

correctness-96: The rename sweep leaves zero `non-developer` mentions outside historical artifacts (plans/, sessions/, evals/, .claude/worktrees/): test fixtures/names, skill prose, CLAUDE.md and Go comments name the mode `casual`.
correctness-97: smine-apply and skillroutine-create stamp `origin: user` (one line after `author:`) on every skill created from a proposal; shipped skills never get it and it is never removed.

correctness-98: smine-skills reads the profile first; on `audience: casual` skill/workflow edit candidates may only target skills whose frontmatter carries `origin: user` — others are dropped, listed as `dropped: casual lockout — <target>` in the run report and never written to skills.json; new-skill proposals stay allowed.

correctness-99: smine-apply hard gate: on a casual install a skills-kind proposal targeting an existing skill without `origin: user` is not implemented and gets disposition `casual-locked` with a one-line note, regardless of vote or auto-apply mode.
correctness-100: smine-orchestrate's judge rejects, on a casual install, any run-branch commit modifying a `skills/*/*/SKILL.md` or its bundled files lacking `origin: user`.

correctness-101: smine-batch routes each session to `sessions/<roster-name>/` from the `--repos` longest-prefix attribution or to `sessions/default/` when unmatched (or no roster), creating the folder on first use; `.batch.scope` carries the folder name; a batch never spans folders; batch numbers continue per folder from 01.

correctness-102: Per-folder ledger `sessions/<name>/analyzed-sessions.txt` is appended per batch; the Select skip-list is the union of all `sessions/*/analyzed-sessions.txt` and `sessions/archived/*/analyzed-sessions.txt`, so nothing mined in any live or archived folder re-mines.

correctness-103: `--scopes` is removed from smine and smine-batch (description, argument-hint, Args, Resolve, Run, workflow args); `--no-batch` cursor resolution covers every folder under sessions/ except archived/; schema.json `batch.scope` keeps the field with the narrowed description.
correctness-104: The four dimension skills' input glob `sessions/*/*batch-*.md` excludes `archived/`, and the sessions store skips the `sessions/archived/` directory when enumerating scopes.

correctness-105: Existing `sessions/personal/` and `sessions/work/` are not auto-migrated and keep serving at their URLs until archived; removing a repo from the registry leaves its sessions folder untouched.

correctness-106: Routes `GET /sessions/archive`, `POST /sessions/{scope}/archive`, `POST /sessions/archive/{name}/unarchive` and `POST /sessions/archive/{name}/delete` are registered; the archive/unarchive/delete handlers render the op result with an HX-Redirect (/sessions resp. /sessions/archive); `POST /sessions/reload`, `handleSessionsReload` and the `sessions-reload` HX-Trigger wiring are removed (404).

correctness-107: Store.ArchiveScope moves `sessions/<name>` to `sessions/archived/<name>` (error when already archived); UnarchiveScope moves it back and errors when a live same-name folder exists (never merges); DeleteScope removes only an archived folder (non-archived name → error); ArchivedFolders lists archived folders with md-report counts (missing dir → empty).

correctness-108: validateScopeName rejects empty, `archived`, `.`, `..`, any name differing from its filepath.Base, and names containing `/` or `\`; `default` stays archivable; no operation touches anything outside sessions/.

correctness-109: Every sessions GET (index, scope, batch, archive tab) and the overview handler call `s.sessions.Reload()` first, logging and still rendering on error, so a batch written while the server runs appears on the next page load without any reload control.

correctness-110: sessions_index.html gains an archive tab link and an 'Archive folder' form (confirm text naming that analyses disappear and nothing re-mines) in place of the Reload button; the empty-state branch also renders the tabs row; new sessions_archive.html lists archived folders with Unarchive and Delete (confirm naming the re-mining consequence) or 'No archived folders.'; the new strings enter germanCatalog and 'Reload from disk' leaves it.

correctness-111: Repo add takes an editable `name` field (empty → folder basename); `Repo.Validate` rejects the reserved names `default` and `archived`; duplicate names keep the existing rejection; the name is validated before any `git init` runs on the folder.
correctness-112: Comments/prose naming scope dirs or work/personal (run.sh comments, smine-orchestrate SKILL.md, README sessions layout) are updated to repo folders + `default` + `archived`.

correctness-113: New `cmd/bootstrap/run.sh` exports MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 and MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*', sources routines/_lib/platform.sh and skill.sh, and preflights: not on `main` or dirty tree → exit 64 with the message; missing jq/shellcheck → warning only; outside dry-run an empty/missing BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE → exit 78, else CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN exported from it.

correctness-114: The wrapper reads language/audience/dev-mode from the profile via sed; dev mode = SMINE_DEV_MODE, else profile `dev-mode: true`; a casual audience forces it off; when the skill overlay exists (non-dry) it is copied to the repo's `.claude/settings.local.json`; `--repos` is built from git-dir entries of `permissions.additionalDirectories`.
